resources.string: Ithuluzi lihlulekile: %1$s. Ungaliphindi ulisebenzise ngalokho okufakile.
Ukusesha kuwebhu akulungiselelwe kule khibhodi, ngakho ukusesha akunakwenzeka. Phendula ngokwalokho okwaziyo kakade bese usho ukuthi awukwazanga ukusesha.
[ikhasi liyaqhubeka ngale kwaleli phuzu futhi linqunyiwe]
Umsebenzisi akazange avumele lokhu kushaya. Ungaphinde ushayele leli thuluzi kule mpendulo. Phendula ngaphandle kwalo, futhi usho lokho obungakwazi ukukwenza.
Iseva icele okwengeziwe okufakiwe, futhi ikhibhodi ayikakwazi ukukunikela okwamanje.
Le seva isebenzisa inguqulo entsha ye-MCP kunaleyo eyaziwa yikhibhodi.
Leli kheli aliphendulanga njengeseva ye-MCP. Hlola ikheli nohlobo.
Le seva idinga ukuthi ungene ngemvume, futhi ikhibhodi ayikakwazi ukukwenza lokho. Uma iseva ikhipha amathokheni noma okhiye, engeza eyodwa njengenhloko.
[ithuluzi liphinde lathumela okuqukethwe ongeke ukufunde lapha: %1$s]
[impendulo iyaqhubeka ngale kwaleli phuzu futhi inqunywe]
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufinyelela isevisi yezithombe. Hlola inethiwekhi yakho bese uzama futhi.
Isevisi yezithombe ithathe isikhathi eside kakhulu ukuphendula
Lesi sikhungo se-SearXNG asikayivuli i-JSON API yaso. Engeza i-json ku-search.formats kuzilungiselelo zayo ze-settings.yml, noma usebenzise esinye isikhungo.

Lesi sikhungo se-SearXNG asisamukeli izinhlelo okwamanje (HTTP 429). Izikhungo zomphakathi zikhawulela izicelo ezingaveli kusiphequluli. Zama futhi kamuva, noma usebenzise isikhungo sakho noma esivumela i-JSON API yaso.
Lelo akulona ikheli lewebhu leli khibhodi elizolivula. Nikeza ikheli eliphelele le-http:// noma https://.
